name: Kodama Comet: Stellar Sanctuary
source:
There are many giant space stations roaming in orbit around earth. Stellar Sanctuary 04 is one of those, and its purpose is to explore the wonders of the dense and mysterious space. The short handed staff hires Euphémia, the main character, to become part of the station's crew. However, it is also on this station that she will make a groundbreaking discovery with the four other members, as they discover the existence of a comet that might disrupt the very fate of mankind...

[From [url=https://kodamasoft.wordpress.com/stellar-sanctuary/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
许多巨大空间站在地球轨道运行。星辰圣所04号就是其中之一，任务是探索浩瀚而神秘宇宙的奇迹。由于人手不足，空间站聘请主人公尤菲米娅加入船员。然而，也正是在这里，她与另外四名成员做出了一项突破性发现：一颗可能改变人类命运的彗星存在于世。

[来源：[url=https://kodamasoft.wordpress.com/stellar-sanctuary/]官方网站[/url]]
